note: Inventory of required evidence *classes* for each of the 12 model/observation freeze fields. Does not invent model/adapter/tokenizer/decoding pins. Not a model-execution authorization. Ledger digest must match the freeze file.

model_artifact_identity.evidence_class_definition: Immutable local/open model artifact identity with content address; no invented path or mutable tag.

adapter_identity_and_version.evidence_class_definition: Reviewed adapter implementation identity and version.

exact_observation_registry.evidence_class_definition: Exact observation channel registry (pre-arm lists source *classes* only).
exact_observation_registry.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationChannelRegistry (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
exact_observation_registry.non_authorizing_note: Candidate schema ModelObservationChannelRegistry is present but does not pin this field; channel names remain caller-supplied

exact_observation_timing.evidence_class_definition: Event timing contract per observation channel.
exact_observation_timing.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationTimingContract (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
exact_observation_timing.non_authorizing_note: Candidate schema ModelObservationTimingContract is present but does not pin this field

primary_pre_assertion_eligibility.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationH11AEligibilityRule (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
primary_pre_assertion_eligibility.non_authorizing_note: Candidate classifier ModelObservationH11AEligibilityRule is present but does not pin this field

development_validation_population_deriva.evidence_class_definition: Closed deterministic Development/Validation population derivation map.

resource_accounting_contract.evidence_class_definition: Numeric envelopes / accounting rules for model instrumentation.
resource_accounting_contract.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationResourceAccountingContract (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
resource_accounting_contract.non_authorizing_note: Candidate taxonomy ModelObservationResourceAccountingContract is present but does not pin this field; numeric maxima remain caller-supplied

typed_rejection_contract.evidence_class_definition: Closed TDI-11.2 model-observation rejection vocabulary. TDI-8.1 / TDI-9.1 rejection pins do not transfer.
typed_rejection_contract.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationRejectionCode (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
typed_rejection_contract.non_authorizing_note: Candidate vocabulary ModelObservationRejectionCode is present but does not pin this field

provenance_contract.evidence_class_definition: Machine-readable provenance schema for model traces.
provenance_contract.blocking_until: reviewed pin of ModelObservationTraceProvenance (scaffolding alone is non-authorizing)
provenance_contract.non_authorizing_note: Candidate schema ModelObservationTraceProvenance is present but does not pin this field
